data.long_description:
OFF-PLAN | BURJ KHALIFA VIEW | PRIVATE POOL | HIGH FLOOR | FULLY FURNISHED | GREAT INVESTMENT

Experience elevated luxury living in this fully furnished 2-bedroom apartment in BAYZ 101 by Danube, located in the heart of Business Bay. Situated on a high floor, this stunning residence offers direct Burj Khalifa views and a rare private pool, providing ultimate privacy and resort-style comfort. The apartment features a modern and spacious layout, elegant interiors, floor-to-ceiling windows, and premium finishes, making it ideal for both investors and end-users.

Key Features:

Private pool for exclusive resort-style living
Fully furnished with high-quality interiors
Spacious 2-bedroom layout with modern design
Floor-to-ceiling windows with breathtaking city and Burj Khalifa views
Flexible payment plan for investors

Building & Amenities:

State-of-the-art gym, swimming pools, and leisure areas
24/7 security for peace of mind
Prime Business Bay location with easy access to Downtown Dubai, Dubai Mall, major highways, and business hubs

This property combines luxury, convenience, and strong long-term investment value in one of Dubai’s most sought-after addresses.
